svg.text: MongoDB / Mongoose. Accent tables are the four the brief names: how Users, Products, Orders and Reviews connect.

g.text: item.vendorEarnings = subtotal − platformFee → $95 to the maker
Split per line item, so one order spanning several shops pays each maker correctly. Recorded in PAYOUT.
Tables the brief names: User, Product, Order (with items), Review
Dashed: the link that makes a review a verified purchase
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UK unique
